name: Skynarium: VR Astronomy Simulator
summary:
# Skynarium: Your Sky. Your Observatory.

Have you ever wondered what the night sky looks like from another place on Earth? Or how the stars moved hundreds of years ago?

**Welcome to Skynarium, an immersive VR astronomy simulator that brings the night sky to life.**
